inputs.original_text: Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for...
inputs.modified_text: This is a welcome move toward holding gunmakers responsible when weapons sold in New York can be easily converted into illegal machine guns. Communities shouldn’t be left to absorb the harm from risks the industry could foresee and prevent. But the proposal’s silence about who would face criminal penalties is a serious weakness: without clear accountability reaching the companies and decision-makers, enforcement could fall hardest on vulnerable people instead. Real reform must make the industry answer for its choices, not turn another vague law into a tool for disproportionate punishment.
